revision_summary: Five quotes in script_coverage have wrong_ts errors (all minor, words exist correctly elsewhere in transcript) that must be corrected on rerun: (1) the credit-score qualifier quote and (2) the customer's 'Yes, ma'am.' response both belong at ts 04:12-04:26, not 02:18 — rename this section from 'tax_credit_qualifier' to 'credit_qualifier' per schema section 5, since 02:18 is actually the bill-anchor moment already covered elsewhere; (3) 'It's done.' belongs at ts 09:02, not 04:39; (4) 'We can do this Monday, the twentieth...' belongs at ts 09:31, not 09:12; (5) '5 would be good.' belongs at ts 09:51, not 09:12. Additionally: reconsider the starting_state characterization of the garbled 00:05 exchange ('Is that really sales at all? Yes. Uh-huh.') — this reads as a transcription artifact/crossed lines rather than clean customer sentiment, and confidence should be softened. Fix or remove the mislabeled 'enthusiasm_signal' cherry-pick moment at 02:09, which duplicates the bill-pain content already covered under bill_anchor and mischaracterizes financial-pain disclosure as enthusiasm. Flag the appointment-channel discrepancy: rep says specialist will 'stop by' (in-person framing) at 09:12, which conflicts with schema's phone-appointment assumption (button_up.phone_appointment_specified) — this should be surfaced as a schema-drift or handoff-brief item rather than silently resolved as 'in_person' in observed_outcome. Finally, soften the 'quick, mechanical fix' framing on the missing no-driving/handshake button-up elements — both are hard_required schema items tied explicitly to no-show rate and deserve more coaching weight than implied.
